About

NoCode started as a side project in October 2016, with the vision to empower and inspire non-technical entrepreneurs and makers. Back then there were only a few scattered tools and very little content online for non-techs building digital products. Two years later the space was booming, with new tools launching every week.

It grew bigger than I ever imagined: original content, guest posts, a community forum, discount codes, 250+ reviewed tools and a newsletter going out to thousands of subscribers.

In September 2018 it was acquired by Concrete Capital, and in 2022 by Stacker. Since I sold it the no-code space has exploded, and makers keep amazing me with what can be built without code.

Version history

  1. Acquired by Stacker2022

    The site moved to its third owner.

  2. Acquired by Concrete CapitalSep 2018

    Sold, then redesigned in Webflow, keeping some of the original look.

  3. Version 1.0Oct 2016

    A side project: a simple directory of tools for non-techs.

Notes from the maker

3 notes
Know your audienceSam, maker

The logo confused everyone and the .tech domain did too. I thought both were glaringly obvious. Nobody got either.

Seafoam, toned downSam, maker

The #66ffcc palette was an eyesore at first, so I softened it after a lot of feedback. I’m still desperate to use it again.

Borrowed a gridSam, maker

The homepage grid was inspired by Startup Stash: easy to navigate and infinitely scalable as I added categories.
